- *(connectivity)* The Hugging Face cache claim is applied by a post-install,post-upgrade hook Job, outside Helm's wait — it Binds with its first predictor, so WaitForFirstConsumer no longer fails the release (giantswarm/agent-platform#483) in [#489](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/489) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
